Xiaopeng He (@xiaopenghexpeng)

Over the past year, many people have asked me:"With XPENG’s robots getting so much attention, why don’t you show them more often?"

It’s simple: I don’t agree.

I believe our robots need to be better, not louder. We shouldn’t be in a rush. We should spend our time on technology, on the product, and on getting the fundamentals right.

Yesterday, XPENG’s robot production line was officially up and running. It feels like we’ve stepped into a whole new chapter. I have a lot of feelings, and honestly, a lot I want to share with you.

So, this video is for all our friends, and for every colleague who has put their heart into this journey. Let’s keep going. One step at a time.
